pairs: Silver has its fissures where it is first found,
et auro locus est in quo conflatur.
and gold has a place where it is melted.
Iron is taken from the earth,
et lapis solutus calore in æs vertitur.
and ore, unbound by heat, is turned into brass.
He has established a time for darkness,
and he has settled on an end for all things,
lapidem quoque caliginis et umbram mortis.
as well as for the stone that is in the gloom and shadow of death.
Dividit torrens a populo peregrinante eos quos oblitus est pes egentis hominis,
The burning separates a pilgrim people from those who have been forgotten by the feet of the destitute man
The land, where bread appeared in its place,
in loco suo igni subversa est.
Its stones are embedded with sapphires,
The bird does not know its path,
nec intuitus est eam oculus vulturis.
nor has the eye of the vulture beheld it.
The sons of merchants have not walked there,
nor has the lioness traveled through it.
He has stretched out his hand to the rocks;
he has overturned the foundations of the mountains.
He has cut rivers through the rocks,
et omne pretiosum vidit oculus ejus.
and his eye has seen all precious things.
The depths of rivers he has also examined,
and he has brought hidden things into the light.
But, in truth, where is wisdom to be found,
and where is the place of understanding?
Man does not know its price,
nec invenitur in terra suaviter viventium.
nor is it found in the land of those who live in sweetness.
Non dabitur aurum obrizum pro ea,
The finest gold will not be paid for it,
nec appendetur argentum in commutatione ejus.
nor will silver be weighed in exchange for it.
It will not be compared with the dyed colors of India,
nor with the very costly stone sardonyx,
Non adæquabitur ei aurum vel vitrum,
Neither gold nor crystal will be its equal;
nec commutabuntur pro ea vasa auri.
neither will vessels of gold be fitted for it.
Excelsa et eminentia non memorabuntur comparatione ejus:
The exalted and the eminent will not be remembered in comparison with it.
Yet wisdom is drawn out of concealment.
Non adæquabitur ei topazius de Æthiopia,
The topaz of Ethiopia will not be equal to it,
nor will it be compared to the purest dyes.
So then, where does wisdom begin,
and where is the place of understanding?
Abscondita est ab oculis omnium viventium:
It has been hidden from the eyes of all living things,
just as the birds of the heavens escape notice.
For he beholds the limits of the world,
et omnia quæ sub cælo sunt respicit.
and he looks upon all things that are under heaven.
He created a counterweight for the winds,
and he suspended the waters to measure them.
he gave a law to the rain and a path to the resounding storms.
Then he saw and explained it,
and he made ready and examined it.
